label: Bill 1 - Baseline clean
narrative: Happy path: a normal monthly bill on a known meter; routes straight to AutoResolve.

label: Bill 2 - Unit mismatch (ccf on a kWh meter)
narrative: Same Liberty Tower main electric meter, but the upload says ccf. UNIT_MISMATCH is the canonical fixable HIGH flag: routes to DraftForHumanReview so the drafter can propose a relabel.

label: Bill 3 - Gap detected
narrative: Bill arrives for July 2026 on Liberty M2; the most recent reading on that meter ends 2026-04-30. The ~62-day gap is high-severity and escalates.

label: Bill 4 - Overlap
narrative: Pacific Plaza main electric; the incoming period (Apr 15 - May 14) overlaps the existing April reading on the same meter. Any overlap is high-severity and escalates.

label: Bill 5 - Unknown provider + unit mismatch
narrative: A small gas meter at Liberty Tower whose provider ('GreenfieldCoop') is not in the reference library. The bill also reports kWh on a therms-locked meter. The unit mismatch routes to DraftForHumanReview; the drafter sees the unknown provider in context and is encouraged to flag the onboarding need in its basis note.

label: Bill 6 - Inactive meter
narrative: Reading received against a meter that exists but is flagged inactive. INACTIVE_METER is a high-severity non-fixable flag; the bill escalates to the inactive-meter queue.
